gnosh prompt

  Read gnosh's own words to the model, and make any of them yours. These start
  no model. A file of yours in the folder gnosh prompt path names stands in
  for gnosh's text of its name in every session from then on. What fills the
  model's window, each tool's share with it, is /context all (in a session, or
  gnosh -p '/context all').

  None of these commands is built yet in this build of gnosh: typing one stops
  with a message that says so.

Usage
  gnosh prompt <command> [flags] [arguments]

Commands
  show [name]             List gnosh's texts to the model, or print one as it
                          is sent. (Not built yet.)
  path                    Print the folder your own texts go in. (Not built
                          yet.)
  export [name...]        Write gnosh's own texts into the folder yours go in,
                          to edit them. (Not built yet.)

Flags
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
